item.title: Site update — Oct 16, 2026
item.description: Lighter punctuation throughout the French and English prose; working paper 1.2: complete Reddit sample, common phrases told apart from Q's own formulas, /pol/ culture in Q threads, duplicate formulas removed from table 4, conclusion extended to the conspiracy scene; editorial review (niaf) taken into account: scope of the precedence tests, modelled status of the Hawkes process, verification counts, abstract and section 4.10 restructured.

item.title: Site update — Oct 16, 2026
item.description: Typefaces (Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Source Serif 4) and chart libraries (Vega, base map) now hosted with the site: no more third-party requests.

item.title: Site update — Oct 16, 2026
item.description: New interface: four sections organised by the reader's question (What Q wrote, Against the facts, Models, Resources), mobile menu, a home page that sets one of Q's claims against the facts and groups findings by question, side contents on long pages, collapsible method notes, legible typefaces (Atkinson Hyperlegible Next, Source Serif 4), French typography (non-breaking spaces before high punctuation and inside quotation marks) on every page, chart and the PDF.

item.title: Site update — Oct 15, 2026
item.description: Scene lexicon: 34 terms added (Q codes, 2016-2019 narratives, promoters, /pol/ culture, hate codes); on /pol/, measured in Q threads and the 1% sample, without a new scan.

item.title: Site update — Oct 15, 2026
item.description: Toxicity of Q on /pol/ broken down by group: Q threads, isolated posts using Q vocabulary, posts citing a promoter (mostly Alex Jones) or a pseudo-insider; the gap between the overall mean and the day-by-day comparison comes from this make-up (Models page, table 5 of the working paper).

item.title: Site update — Oct 15, 2026
item.description: Q on /pol/, its cradle: 134.5 million posts read in full; birth of Q's formulas on /pol/, share of Q threads, /pol/'s response to Q sessions, toxicity, hate codes and the vocabulary specific to Q threads (Models page, section 4.10 of the working paper).

item.title: Site update — Oct 14, 2026
item.description: Models page: Markov chains (hidden regimes, topic sequences, style drift), physics analogies (Hawkes process and Omori law, long memory, avalanches, phases) and Q within the American conspiracy scene (Reddit, Wikipedia, Google Trends, 4chan /pol/); working paper 1.1 (sections 4.8 and 4.9).
